functions.name: central_function
functions.description: Estimation of DNAm age per cohort (pooled across nodes)

arguments.name: lista_relojes
arguments.description: pyaging clocks to calculate. Default: horvath2013, hannum, pcphenoage and pedbe (paediatric buccal clock). Any other pyaging clock name can be given, e.g. dnamphenoage (Levine DNAm PhenoAge), zhangen, weidner, lin, bocklandt or corticalclock (Shireby).

arguments.name: cohort_column
arguments.description: Name of the column in each node's data that holds the cohort of each sample. Results are computed per cohort.

arguments.name: min_samples
arguments.description: Minimum number of samples a cohort needs on a node to be included in that node's result (at least 2). Cohorts below this threshold are dropped on the node.

arguments.name: coverage_threshold
arguments.description: Minimum coverage (share of a clock's CpGs present in a node's data, 0-1) for a result to be flagged coverage_ok. EPIC v2 lacks some clock CpGs and pyaging fills them with reference values or 0, which can bias the age. It only sets the flag; no clock or result is removed.
